checks.note: The short_clips fact reports all 7 segments narrated in en, es and zh-Hans, longest narration 33.92 s (zh-Hans segment 6), under the 35 s ceiling; the longest running time, 36.32 s for that same segment, is the title card and pauses the rubric allows. The chapter lists in guide-en-desktop.png (0:10 to 0:27), guide-es-desktop.png (0:16 to 0:34) and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png (0:15 to 0:36) show seven chapters at those lengths, so nothing is one long video any more.

The no_owl fact searched 18 files and found no match. In guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png the four panels are the head with the mastoid dressing, a hand pulling the bandage off, the incision behind the ear, and a magnified ear showing the tape strips over the incision. Surgical site and anatomy, no mascot anywhere a patient looks, including the phone views.

The narrator fact reports one voice, George, for each of the three narrated languages, and no character. The transcripts in all six guide screenshots address the patient directly ("Two days after surgery, remove the head bandage" / "Dos días después de la cirugía, quítese el vendaje mastoideo"), with no character speaking and no character on screen.

The subtitles fact lists captions for segments 1-7 in en, es and zh-Hans. At 1280x800 the caption bar sits under the picture with its checkbox on: Captions in guide-en-desktop.png, Subtítulos in guide-es-desktop.png, 字幕 in guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png, each showing the spoken sentence at a readable size. At 375x812 the transcript under the player carries the same sentence in large type with the spoken word highlighted (guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-phone.png), which is the caption layout chosen on purpose. One cosmetic note, not a failure: the Mandarin highlight falls on "天后，" and so splits 两天后 mid-word; the caption text itself is correct and complete.

The toc fact lists 7 chapters and every jump landed exactly on its expected start (0, 9.76, 30.56, 54.64, 68.08, 88.16, 114.56 s) with the right chapter going active, and all chapters visible at 1280x800 in all three languages. The desktop screenshots show the numbered list with titles and durations in the left rail; the phone screenshots show a CHAPTER 1 OF 7 selector with back, forward and a dropdown, so the patient can still reach any chapter.

The languages fact matched the expected first sentence and a per-language audio file for both es (assets/audio/v2/es/bandage-off.mp3) and zh-Hans, with no error status. The screenshots confirm the whole page turns over, not just the text: guide-es-desktop.png has Idioma, Imprimir la tarjeta, Reproducir, Velocidad, Subtítulos, Spanish chapter titles, Spanish transcript and a Spanish panel label "Revise si hay cinta"; guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png has 语言, 打印卡片, 播放, 速度, 字幕 and 检查有没有胶布. No stray English in either.

The provider_file fact measured 39 ms from pasting the block to having the link, two steps (paste, copy), zero account or login fields and no network requests after load, so nothing is signed into and nothing is installed. provider-filled.png shows the four columns Antibiotic, Pain medication, Follow-up and Language, each reading the provider's value with From = "your block", plus the fifth Reviewed by row; guide-from-link.png opens that link in Spanish with "Su revisión de la herida y examen del oído: 1 de octubre de 2026" in the transcript. In provider-draft.png, where the dot phrase is pasted with its *** still in it, the page does not presume a value: each of those four rows says it cannot read the line and asks for one choice, and the follow-up row offers its "Use “about two weeks”" preset in one tap. Four taps is still well under a minute, and the page states that a line left out uses its preset.

The review_line fact shows a single line in the block, "Video guide: language {English/Spanish/Mandarin}    Reviewed by *** on ***", no clinician badge, and no review date in the link; the link fragment in the provider_file fact is #a=0&p=1&f=2026-10-01&l=es, which carries the follow-up date and language only. The page says the same thing in both states: "Stays in your note. The patient's guide shows no reviewer line." in provider-draft.png and "Not shown to the patient, and not carried in the link. It stays in your note." in provider-filled.png. guide-from-link-badges.png, scrolled to the end of the transcript, shows no reviewer line, so the page tells the truth.

The card_summary fact has the card on the first screen at both widths and the card itself returning 200. "Print the card" sits in the header at 1280x800 (guide-en-desktop.png) and in the controls without scrolling at 375x812 (guide-en-phone.png), in the patient's language in the other two: Imprimir la tarjeta, 打印卡片. One tap either way.
